ابتليتما (form VIII)
# اِبْتَلَيْتُمَا (ibtalaytumā) /ib.ta.laj.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of اِبْتَلَى (ibtalā)
# اُبْتُلِيتُمَا (ubtulītumā) /ub.tu.liː.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of اِبْتَلَى (ibtalā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
